segments.name: Data storage
segments.description: Sells an integrated flash-based storage and data management platform to enterprises, spanning on-premises, hybrid, public cloud and edge environments, with subscription services.
segments.evidence: Our chief operating decision maker (CODM), the Chief Executive Officer, manages business activities as a single operating and reportable segment at the consolidated level.

revenueModel.text: Customers pay for storage products and subscribe to storage capabilities and service levels rather than to a specific hardware configuration.
